newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Freight Links to buy Caxton.
newsitem.headline: Freight Links to buy Caxton.

text.p: Freight Links Express Holdings Ltd said on Friday it had entered into a conditional agreement to buy 8.15 million shares of 50 Australian cents each in Caxton Holdings Ltd for A$5.5 million from Eftus Investments Pty Ltd.
The company said in a statement the sale of shares represented 85 percent of the issued and paid-up capital of Caxton.

Freight Links said the purchase was conditional upon the approval of the Foreign Investment Review Board in Australia and the shareholders of Caxton. It was expected to be completed on December 13 and would be funded from internal resources and bank borrowings.
Freight Links said it planned to use Caxton to expand the group's activities in freight forwarding, warehousing and distribution in Australia.
